stem: (Select TWO.) Bellweather Analytics needs the correct order and scope of its configuration checks. Which two statements are correct?

choices.text: Terraform evaluates postconditions before it evaluates preconditions, on every resource in the configuration
A `precondition` block can reference a resource's own final attributes through `self`, the same way a `postcondition` can
Terraform executes input variable validations immediately, before it generates a plan
A variable `validation` block can only evaluate the variable it is attached to, not a resource's computed attributes
`check` blocks run before Terraform generates a plan, ahead of every other kind of condition

rationale: Reversing the order -- claiming postconditions run before preconditions -- misstates the actual sequence: Terraform evaluates preconditions after generating a plan but before creating the object, and postconditions only afterward. Claiming a precondition can reference `self` is wrong, since `self` refers to an object that doesn't exist yet at precondition time -- `self` is a postcondition tool. And `check` blocks run at the end of a plan or apply operation, not before a plan exists.
